facts.text: I am looking for new Mexican recipes to try out.
I have been getting into Mexican cooking lately.
I attempted to make homemade tortillas for the first time the week before my recent attempt.
My first homemade tortillas attempt was a disaster because the dough was too sticky.
My first homemade tortillas were uneven, fragile, and fell apart when I tried to fold them.
I learned from my mistakes and tried making homemade tortillas again a few days later.
On my second homemade tortillas attempt, I added more flour.
On my second homemade tortillas attempt, I let the dough rest for longer.
My second homemade tortillas attempt was much better.
I used my second homemade tortillas to make delicious chicken fajitas.
My chicken fajitas included sautéed onions and bell peppers.
I am interested in trying out new fillings for my homemade tortillas.
I like mushrooms and I am a big fan of mushrooms.
I want to try a grilled portobello mushroom and Oaxaca cheese filling.
I want to add sautéed onions and garlic to the mushroom mixture.
I plan to sauté the onions and garlic before adding the mushrooms.
I plan to mix the onions, garlic, mushrooms, and Oaxaca cheese together.
I might add dried oregano and a squeeze of lime juice to the filling.
I plan to serve pico de gallo salsa with my tacos.
I plan to top my tacos with pickled onions.
I plan to top my tacos with cilantro.
I plan to top my tacos with queso fresco.
I might add sliced radishes on top for extra texture and flavor.
I want tips for making homemade tortillas just right.

events.text: First attempt at homemade tortillas ended in a disaster due to sticky dough and fragile tortillas.
Second attempt at homemade tortillas improved after adding more flour and letting the dough rest longer.
Used the improved homemade tortillas to make chicken fajitas with sautéed onions and bell peppers.
